{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2017–18 |team=Chicago State Cougars |image=Chicago State Athletics wordmark.png |image_size=200 |conference=Western Athletic Conference |division= |short_conf=WAC |APRank= |CoachRank= |record= 3–29 |conf_record= 1–13 |head_coach=[[Tracy Dildy]] |hc_year = 8th |asst_coach1=James Farr |asst_coach2=Matt Raidbard |asst_coach3=Eddie Denard |stadium=[[Emil and Patricia Jones Convocation Center|Jones Convocation Center]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2017–18 WAC men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Chicago State Cougars men's basketball team''' represented [[Chicago State University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Cougars, led by eighth-year head coach [[Tracy Dildy]], played their home games at the [[Emil and Patricia Jones Convocation Center]] as members of the [[Western Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 3–29, 1–13 in WAC play to finish in last place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]] to [[2017–18 New Mexico State Aggies men's basketball team|New Mexico State]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401020539|title=Chicago State vs. New Mexico State - Game Recap - March 8, 2018 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2018-03-13}} The Cougars had the worst average point margin in Division I at –22.7 points, despite winning two games by over 40 points.{{cite web|title=NCAA BB Team Average Scoring Margin|url=https://www.teamrankings.com/ncaa-basketball/stat/average-scoring-margin|website=TeamRankings.com}} After the season, Chicago State fired Dildy during the week of March 5, 2018, although it was not officially announced until a week later.{{cite news|url=https://chicagocrusader.com/chicago-state-fires-womens-and-mens-basketball-coaches/|title=Chicago State fires women's and men's basketball coaches|first=J. Coyden|last=Palmer|website=chicagocrusader.com|date=March 15, 2018|accessdate=March 21, 2018}} After a nearly a five-month search, [[Lance Irvin]], a Chicago native and former assistant coach at [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul]] and several other schools, was named the new head coach of the Cougars on August 7.{{cite news|url=http://www.chicagotribune.com/sports/college/ct-spt-chicago-state-hires-basketball-coaches-20180807-story.html|title=Chicago State hires new women's and men's basketball coaches|newspaper=[[Chicago Tribune]]|date=August 7, 2018|accessdate=August 9, 2018}} ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Chicago State Cougars men's basketball team|Cougars]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 6–26, 1–13 in WAC play to finish in last place. Due to [[2016–17 Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball team|Grand Canyon]]'s ineligibility for postseason play, they received the No. 7 seed in the [[2017 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]] where they lost in the quarterfinals to [[2016–17 New Mexico State Aggies men's basketball team|New Mexico State]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
